Instructions for Use
Device description: The Delta Neurostimulation System is a spinal cord stimulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Delta Neurostimulation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
- Static magnetic field of 1.5 T or 3 T
- Maximum spatial field gradient of 1,000 G/cm or less
- Gradient slew rate limited to 150 T/m/s per axis
- At 1.5 T: B1+RMS of 2.8 microtesla or less; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg; Scan for up to 10 minutes
- At 3 T: Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4-W/kg
- Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
- Head Transmit/Receive Coil ONLY
- Receive with the head transmit/receive coil
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Delta Neurostimulation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
